Customers contract directly with and pay ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD for approved orders. Independent suppliers, procurement contractors, and logistics providers may be used by ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD to support fulfillment of customer orders; those parties do not separately collect customer payments through our website. ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD coordinates shipment and carrier services as part of fulfilling customer procurement and order-fulfillment requirements. Shipping coordination is not offered as a standalone transportation service. Independent logistics providers perform the physical transportation of goods.
